title: zainab ne kaha yeh ro ro kar
body:
zainab ne kaha yeh ro ro kar
<<MINI>>
abbas na jao dariya par
<<DIVIDER>>
barbaad na ho shabbir ka ghar
<<MINI>>
abbas na jao dariya par
<<DIVIDER>>
1. maqtal mein udasi chayi hai
qaimon mein qayamat aayegi
ho jayegi zainab be chadar
<<MINI>>
abbas na jao dariya par
<<DIVIDER>>
2. sab ahle haram ki aas ho tum
zehra ki dua abbas ho tum
batlao jiye kaise sarwar
<<MINI>>
abbas na jao dariya par
<<DIVIDER>>
3. khurbaan huwe nazon ke pale
lo tum bhi humko chod chale
dil phat ta hai bhai rehreh kar
<<MINI>>
abbas na jao dariya par
<<DIVIDER>>
4. lutne ko hai ab zehra ka jaha
dariya ki zamee hai nauha kuna
chalte hai mere dil par khanjar
<<MINI>>
abbas na jao dariya par
<<DIVIDER>>
5.marjaye na kyun zainab gham se
himmat hai tumhare hi dum se
is tarha behan ko tadpa kar
<<MINI>>
abbas na jao dariya par
<<DIVIDER>>
6. main ran mein tadapna bhai ka
kis tarha se dekhungi bhaiya
katege layi shabbir ka sar
<<MINI>>
abbas na jao dariya par
<<DIVIDER>>
7. manzar hai yahi rawi ka baya
karte the haram faryad-o-fuga
kehti thi behan jab ro ro kar
<<MINI>>
abbas na jao dariya par
